Interactive group game

EntreNous.Point

The interactive game that gets people talking.

Who is it for?

HR teams, businesses, associations, team-building facilitators, seminars, workshops and groups of friends.

The problem to solve

Group pressure can hold back honest answers. An interactive game helps everyone participate and opens up discussion.

What the project offers

  • 01Interactive questionnaire on each participant’s phone
  • 02Anonymous answers and live group results
  • 03Dashboard to facilitate discussion
  • 04Automatic deletion of session data at midnight

The story behind it

Create a space where people can answer honestly without group pressure.

Functional

Where does it stand?

Updated: 1 November 2026

Built, functional app tested at two events. Registration collects email addresses; GDPR work remains to be finalized before expanding outreach to HR teams and event organizers. Demo on request.
